Who We Are

A manufacturer first, a global supplier second — never a reseller.

BIO-ACORNS GLOBAL is engaged directly in the manufacturing and supply of natural agri-based food products. We don't buy finished stock and relabel it — we run the process ourselves, from raw material to packed product, which is what lets us guarantee quality and hold a price that works for bulk and international buyers.

Our current product lines cover jaggery cubes, jaggery powder, and mustard oil, supplied to retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and importers both within India and across international markets.

  • Owned manufacturing process, not outsourced repacking
  • Direct farm-linked raw material sourcing
  • Export packaging and documentation support for overseas orders

How It's Made

From raw material to dispatch

Every batch — solid or liquid, for a local order or an export container — moves through the same disciplined sequence.

01

Sourcing

Raw sugarcane and mustard seed sourced directly from farm partners, selected for quality at intake.

02

Cleaning

Raw material is cleaned and sorted to remove impurities before it enters processing.

03

Extraction

Cane juice is boiled down; mustard seed is cold-pressed in a kachi ghani unit to retain natural properties.

04

Filtering

Product is filtered to remove residue, without chemical clarifying agents.

05

Molding & Packing

Jaggery is set and cut into cubes or powdered; oil is filled and sealed by pack size.

06

QC & Dispatch

Each batch is checked before it's labeled, boxed, and handed off for domestic or export delivery.

Made In India

Common Questions

Before you enquire

Quick answers to what most buyers ask first. Review and adjust these to match your actual policies before publishing.

What's the minimum order quantity?+

MOQ varies by product and pack size — retail cartons and bulk/container orders are both accommodated. Share your target quantity in the enquiry form and we'll confirm what's possible.

Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?+

Yes. Samples are available for evaluation before you commit to a bulk or export order, so you can check quality firsthand.

Do you ship internationally?+

Yes, we supply both domestically and to international buyers, and can work with FOB or CIF terms depending on your preference.

Can products be supplied under my own brand label?+

Private labeling and custom packaging are available for wholesale and export orders — share your branding requirements when you enquire.

What are your payment terms?+

Payment terms are discussed and confirmed per order based on quantity and destination. Let us know your preference and we'll work out what's feasible.

How long does delivery take?+

Lead time depends on order size, packaging, and destination. We'll share an estimated timeline along with your quote.
